name.baseName: Tongwei TWMNH-66HS (TNC-G12R-66 Half Cell Bifacial Module) (photovoltaic module)

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: This EPD is based on the life cycle assessment of the photovoltaic module TWMNH-66HS which is produced and distributed by Tongwei Co., Ltd., located in Nantong City (P. R. China). The EPD refers to the specific product. EPD type: Cradle to Grave + Module D. Kiwa-Ecobility Experts assumes no liability for manufacturer's information, LCA data and evidence. Functional unit: 1 Wp of manufactured photovoltaic module, from cradle-to-grave, with activities needed for a study period for a defined reference service life (≥80% of the labelled power output). Note: The EPD results have been calculated for the declared / functional unit of m^2 and Wp. The results displayed in this dataset refer to the declared unit of m^2. The m^2 results can be converted into the Wp functional unit with a conversion factor (1/235.08) or can be seen in the EPD document.

epd:scenario.epd:name: Standard scenario
epd:scenario.epd:description: Transport to manufacturer (A2): It was assumed that all transportation from suppliers is carried out using trucks. The environmental profile used for this purpose is "T0001 - Lorry (Truck), unspecified (default) | market group for (GLO).". Production process (A3) | Production waste: The production waste data was based on the data sheets provided by the manufacturer. It is assumed that the waste scenarios for both production waste and end-of-life waste are similar. Production process (A3) | Energy consumption: The energy consumption data was sourced from the manufacturer based on the onsite production data. Since the production takes place in China, the electricity grid mix for China is applied, using the environmental profile "Electricity, medium voltage {CN} | market group for | Cut-off, U."

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: The production data have been collected for the year 2024 (01/01/2024 – 31/07/2024) and are there-fore up-to-date.

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: The product is produced and manufactured in Nantong City, Jiangsu Province, P. R. China, and the main market areas are China, the European Union, the Middle East, Latin America, etc. The geographical reference area is China and Europe.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse: TWMNH-66HS is part of Tongwei G12R-TNC series of photovoltaic module products, which adopts the new efficient N-type TNC cell independently developed by Tongwei for module packaging and integrates the industry-leading multi-main gate design to reduce hidden crack loss, non-destructive slicing technology to smooth and flat cutting surface, high-density packaging technology to improve the "screen ratio" of the module to ensure the perfect balance of efficiency and reliability. G12R products are optimized on the traditional 182 products, based on the mainstream mode of transportation, to maximize the utilization of containers and reduce transportation costs. In addition, G12R products with significantly increased product power, reduce integration costs, improve system benefits, bring higher product value, customer value. TWMNH-66HS has a power output range from 610 W to 635 W and a weight of 29.0 kg. 635 W is chosen as the representative product power output. The manufacturing site is located in No. 8, Bonded 10 Road, Economic Development Zone, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province, P. R. China.
